1	# =============================================================================
2	# Paperclip — Cloudflare Workers deployment configuration
3	#
4	# After running `wrangler deploy` for the first time, fill in the placeholder
5	# IDs that Cloudflare generates (search for "FILL_IN_AFTER_DEPLOY").
6	#
7	# Quick start:
8	#   1. wrangler deploy
9	#   2. wrangler hyperdrive create paperclip-hyperdrive --connection-string="<neon-url>"
10	#      Then paste the returned ID into [hyperdrive] binding below.
11	#   3. Open https://<your-worker>.workers.dev/setup to complete first-run setup.
12	# =============================================================================
13	
14	name = "paperclip-api"
15	compatibility_date = "2024-09-23"
16	compatibility_flags = ["nodejs_compat"]
17	main = "src/worker/api.ts"
18	
19	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
20	# Pages — serves the React UI build from ui/dist
21	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
22	[pages_build_output_dir]
23	path = "../../ui/dist"
24	
25	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
26	# Variables (non-secret; override secrets via `wrangler secret put`)
27	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
28	[vars]
29	DEPLOYMENT_PLATFORM = "cloudflare"
30	DEPLOYMENT_MODE = "authenticated"
31	DEPLOYMENT_EXPOSURE = "public"
32	
33	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
34	# R2 object storage — artifacts, skill bundles, attachments, DB backups
35	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
36	[[r2_buckets]]
37	binding = "PAPERCLIP_STORAGE"
38	bucket_name = "paperclip-storage"
39	# preview_bucket_name = "paperclip-storage-preview"
40	
41	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
42	# KV — sessions cache, hot config, first-run setup flag
43	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
44	[[kv_namespaces]]
45	binding = "PAPERCLIP_KV"
46	id = "FILL_IN_AFTER_DEPLOY"
47	# preview_id = "FILL_IN_AFTER_DEPLOY_PREVIEW"
48	
49	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
50	# Hyperdrive — Phase 1: wraps Neon/Postgres for low-latency DB access
51	# After deploying: wrangler hyperdrive create paperclip-hyperdrive --connection-string="<neon-url>"
52	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
53	[[hyperdrive]]
54	binding = "HYPERDRIVE"
55	id = "FILL_IN_AFTER_DEPLOY"
56	
57	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
58	# Queues — background fanout (cost rollups, activity log flush, plugin jobs)
59	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
60	[[queues.producers]]
61	binding = "PAPERCLIP_QUEUE"
62	queue = "paperclip-jobs"
63	
64	[[queues.consumers]]
65	queue = "paperclip-jobs"
66	max_batch_size = 10
67	max_batch_timeout = 5
68	max_retries = 3
69	dead_letter_queue = "paperclip-jobs-dlq"
70	
71	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
72	# Durable Objects — per-task state, per-agent-run state, scheduler alarms
73	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
74	[[durable_objects.bindings]]
75	name = "TASK_DO"
76	class_name = "TaskDO"
77	
78	[[durable_objects.bindings]]
79	name = "AGENT_RUN_DO"
80	class_name = "AgentRunDO"
81	
82	[[durable_objects.bindings]]
83	name = "SCHEDULER_DO"
84	class_name = "SchedulerDO"
85	
86	# DO migrations — bump new_classes when adding a new DO class
87	[[migrations]]
88	tag = "v1"
89	new_classes = ["TaskDO", "AgentRunDO", "SchedulerDO"]
90	
91	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
92	# Workflows — checkpointed multi-step agent execution
93	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
94	[[workflows]]
95	binding = "HEARTBEAT_WORKFLOW"
96	name = "heartbeat-workflow"
97	class_name = "HeartbeatWorkflow"
98	script_name = "paperclip-api"
99	
100	[[workflows]]
101	binding = "PLUGIN_DISPATCH_WORKFLOW"
102	name = "plugin-dispatch-workflow"
103	class_name = "PluginDispatchWorkflow"
104	script_name = "paperclip-api"
105	
106	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
107	# Cron triggers — fire heartbeat sweep, budget checks, DB backup
108	# Adjust intervals to taste; avoid high-frequency triggers (see CLOUDFLARE.md §10)
109	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
110	[triggers]
111	crons = [
112	  "*/5 * * * *",   # heartbeat sweep every 5 minutes
113	  "0 * * * *",     # budget threshold check every hour
114	  "0 3 * * *",     # DB backup daily at 03:00 UTC
115	]
116
